source: client product brief — E-6034 matte vinyl wrap-around label (EN/ZH)

title.zh: E-6034 · 雾面 VINYL 缠绕标签

tagline.en: Flexible wrap-around labels for wire, cable and equipment identification
tagline.zh: 柔性缠绕标签，适用于线缆、线束及户外设备标识

positioning.en: E-6034 is a flexible matte vinyl label material designed for wrap-around identification of wires, cables and industrial equipment. Its soft vinyl construction conforms easily to curved surfaces, while the permanent acrylic adhesive delivers reliable long-term bonding on plastics, painted metals and coated surfaces. Resistant to moisture, UV exposure, oils and abrasion, E-6034 provides durable identification for both indoor and outdoor applications.
positioning.zh: E-6034 是一款专为线缆、线束及工业设备标识设计的雾面 VINYL 标签材料。柔软的乙烯基面材能够紧密贴合线缆、管件及各种曲面，配合高性能永久性丙烯酸胶，在塑料、金属、粉末喷涂及玻璃等多种基材上保持稳定粘接。具备优异的耐水、耐油、耐紫外线及耐磨性能，可满足室内外长期标识需求。

en: Flexible for curved surfaces — soft matte vinyl conforms to wires, cables, tubes and irregular surfaces without lifting or wrinkling.
Strong permanent adhesion — high-performance acrylic adhesive bonds securely to plastics, painted metal, powder coatings, glass and fiberglass.
Built for harsh environments — withstands water, oil, UV exposure, abrasion and salt spray for long-lasting identification.
Clear, reliable printing — the matte surface delivers excellent thermal-transfer print quality and barcode readability with reduced glare.
zh: 柔软贴合，不易翘边 —— 柔性 VINYL 面材可轻松缠绕各种线缆、管路及异形曲面，贴合牢固，不易起翘。
强力持久粘接 —— 永久性丙烯酸胶适用于塑料、喷涂金属、玻璃、玻纤等多种表面，长期使用依然稳定可靠。
适应严苛环境 —— 耐水、耐油、耐紫外线、耐磨损，可满足户外及工业环境的长期使用要求。
清晰打印，易于识别 —— 雾面表面减少反光，支持热转印打印，文字、二维码和条码清晰易读。
